notes: Rules for Claude now show as one Rules row in Properties; View Rules opens a window with every rule in full, where it comes from and who last edited it. The elbow check now looks only for a pipe continuing past the corner, so a short stub to a cap (a rodding eye) is caught and plain bends no longer raise false alarms. When Claude places something against a drawing check, one record note per page is left, clear of the pipes. With a note selected, a middle-click on the drawing adds a pin to it (a middle drag still pans). Also: the pipe at an arrow tip is named correctly where a pipe ends at a cap, drop or tee, and pages in a folder whose parent folder is missing are no longer left out.
